name: FLUX.1 Fill [pro]
description: FLUX.1 Fill [pro] is Black Forest Labs' professional inpainting and outpainting model. It repaints only the masked part of an image from a text prompt, blending seamlessly with the rest, and can also fill transparent areas or extend an image past its borders.

examples.name: Replace Text on a Poster
examples.description: Rewrites only the masked title and keeps the rest of the poster untouched. Image and mask from BFL's FLUX.1 Fill docs.

input.prompt: A movie poster with the title "FLUX PILL" in bold yellow letters

code_snippets.label: typescript
curl

examples.name: Swap an Outfit
examples.description: Changes only the masked jacket; the face, pose and background stay the same. Image and mask from Black Forest Labs' official examples.

input.prompt: a man in a tailored olive-green wool jacket

code_snippets.label: typescript

metadata.Mask: Separate black-and-white mask or alpha channel

image.description: Image to edit, as an HTTPS URL, data URI or base64. Transparent areas are filled when no mask is sent.

mask.description: Black-and-white mask the same size as the image: white areas are repainted, black areas are kept.

prompt.description: What to paint into the masked area.

steps.description: Number of generation steps, 15-50. Defaults to 50.

guidance.description: How strongly to follow the prompt, 1.5-100. Defaults to 60.

prompt_upsampling.description: Let the model rewrite the prompt for a more creative result. Defaults to false.

safety_tolerance.description: Moderation level, from 0 (strictest) to 6 (most permissive). Defaults to 2.

output_format.description: Output image format. Defaults to jpeg.
